title: R1-C contrast / falsification / negative-knowledge recovery
human_intent: Recover Prometeo LAB R1-C / AMP-1 / AMP-2 contrast, falsification and negative knowledge into durable external state so later workers do not repeat rejected approaches or depend on old chats.
already_decided: Current/Catalog/Lineage and exact current contracts outrank historical R1-C chat conclusions.
The original PROMETEO_R1C_AMP2.zip bytes and the exact 40 NK-C entries / CR-C records were not recovered from Git, current conversation files or Library; do not fabricate them.
Historical run counts are evidence of work performed, not authority, acceptance, implementation or empirical truth.
Designed falsification attempts are not empirical falsifications unless execution evidence exists.
R1-C negative knowledge is reusable as a guardrail only after reconciliation against later authority.
This workstream owns recovered contrast/negative-knowledge metadata only; it does not own Navigator, PageKit, persistence, release, Calendar, Finance or Capture implementations.
write_scope: coordination/DELTA_FEED.json only for genuinely cross-workstream recovered rules
high_value_targets: Keep a machine-readable register of recovered R1-C failure knowledge and its current-authority reconciliation.
Prevent future agents from reintroducing duplicate owners, central mutable coordination, version-number authority, environment-unspecified PASS claims or fabricated historical NK/CR records.
If authentic AMP artifacts are later recovered, reconcile exact entries against this normalized register without silently promoting historical decisions.
known_failures: Treating quantity of tests/alternatives as proof of correctness or authority.
Inventing exact historical record contents from aggregate metrics.
Assuming a consumer or local key implies subsystem ownership.
Treating URL/browser back as equivalent to semantic Exact Back.
Creating a central event journal or shared mutable worker-status file for coordination convenience.
Assuming a later version globally supersedes earlier accepted capability scope.
